kills.property: For any caller and any initialize(...) arguments, the reference contract always sets baseToken to the provided _baseToken parameter; the mutant overrides baseToken with msg.sender, so there exist inputs (when msg.sender != _baseToken) where baseToken differs after initialize.
kills.change_summary: Insert an additional assignment after existing baseToken set to override with msg.sender, causing baseToken to become the initializer address.

kills.property: For any initialize(...) call the reference contract sets baseToken equal to the provided _baseToken argument (i.e. c.baseToken() == _baseToken); the mutant sets baseToken to the factory address instead, so there exist inputs where c.baseToken() != _baseToken.
kills.change_summary: Replace assignment to baseToken so initialize sets baseToken to factory address instead of the provided _baseToken.

kills.property: For any initialize(...) call the contract stores changeFee equal to the provided _changeFee; the mutant overrides that and stores uint56.max instead, so the stored changeFee will differ for some inputs (any _changeFee != type(uint56).max).
kills.change_summary: Replace assignment to changeFee with assigning maximal uint56 value, so stored changeFee differs (large value) after initialize.

kills.property: For any uint16 feeRate input ≤ 5000 passed to initialize, the deployed contract's public feeRate equals that input (reference); the mutant ignores the input and sets feeRate to 100, so the property will fail for inputs != 100.
kills.change_summary: Set feeRate to a fixed constant (100) instead of using the provided _feeRate parameter.

kills.property: For any inputs to initialize, the deployed contract's public baseToken equals the _baseToken argument passed to initialize; the mutant sets baseToken to address(0) unconditionally and thus violates this when _baseToken != address(0).
kills.change_summary: Replace assignment to baseToken so initialize sets baseToken to address(0) regardless of the provided _baseToken parameter.

kills.property: After initialize(...) completes, the contract's nft getter returns exactly the address passed as the _nft argument; the mutant assigns nft = _baseToken so for some inputs nft() != the _nft argument and thus violates this rule.
kills.change_summary: Replace the assignment to nft with assigning a different argument (_baseToken) so that nft stored after initialize differs.

kills.property: For any inputs to initialize, the reference contract sets baseToken equal to the supplied _baseToken argument; the mutant erroneously sets baseToken to the supplied _nft argument, so for some fuzzed inputs the stored baseToken will differ from the _baseToken parameter (causing the property to fail).
kills.change_summary: Replace assignment to baseToken so initialize sets baseToken to nft address (swapped), making baseToken equal to the provided _nft.

kills.property: For any inputs to initialize, the correct contract sets baseToken to the provided _baseToken (so c.baseToken() == _baseToken after initialize returns), whereas the mutant that omits assigning baseToken will leave c.baseToken() unchanged for some inputs (i.e. c.baseToken() != _baseToken).
kills.change_summary: Delete the assignment to baseToken so initialize leaves baseToken unchanged (retains default or prior value).

kills.property: For any inputs to initialize, the stored changeFee equals the provided _changeFee (i.e. c.changeFee() == _changeFee); the mutant increments the stored value breaking this equality for some inputs.
kills.change_summary: Replace assignment to changeFee with assigning changeFee + 1 (incrementing provided value), so stored changeFee differs after initialize.

kills.property: For any inputs to initialize, the contract's stored changeFee equals the _changeFee argument passed (i.e., initialize preserves the provided changeFee); the mutant sets changeFee to zero causing this to differ for some nonzero _changeFee inputs.
kills.change_summary: Replace assignment to changeFee with assigning zero, so stored changeFee is 0 after initialize regardless of argument.
